iconicAnchor.label: World-anchored augmented-reality object and annotation
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: ARCore anchors make digital objects appear to remain at a fixed position and orientation in physical space as environmental understanding and camera pose update.

sources.title: Working with Anchors
supports: Anchors keep virtual content attached to a world-space pose as environmental understanding changes.
Objects should remain near their anchor so registration behaves believably.

sources.title: Spatial layout
supports: Distance, occlusion, shadow, reflection, and scale communicate depth and must agree with physical experience.
Spatial content should live in the environment, preserve a comfortable field of view, and use depth only when it clarifies hierarchy or task.

bundledReferenceRationale: The bicycle brake-alignment view is an excellent lead. Camera-world anchoring, component outlines, planar overlays, depth-aware measurements, step instruction, and tool controls clearly teach spatial AR rather than a flat dashboard. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/spatial-ar-interface/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
